packageRules.description: Bun follows the Bun of the pinned Windmill image (WR-3, ADR 0001); it moves only with the semantics pin.

The SDK typecheck, the npm package's declaration build and its packaging test use the type declarations of the pinned Bun (harnesses/bun/test/typecheck, harnesses/package.json, harnesses/npm/test/project); they move only with Bun.
The packaging test's project is the project that bun init of the pinned Bun makes, whose peer dependency is TypeScript 7 (harnesses/npm/test/project): only updates within 7.
The packaging test's second TypeScript is the alias typescript-6 (harnesses/npm/test/project): only updates within 6.
The packaging test's third TypeScript is the alias typescript-5 (harnesses/npm/test/project): only updates within 5.
The SDK typecheck's second set of declarations is the oldest @types/node a host is expected to use (harnesses/bun/test/typecheck/oldest): only updates within 24.
The jsonb test image follows the oracle's PostgreSQL major; only digest and patch updates within 16.
The Windmill oracle image is the semantics pin (v1.767.0); it is never bumped by Renovate.
The oracle and parity workflows' Node runs the pinned windmill-cli@1.767.0 (OR-8); its major moves only with the oracle pin.
The native runtime's embedded client is the version Windmill v1.767.0 embeds (WR-40: OpenAPI.VERSION 1.326.0); it moves only with the semantics pin.
The CI workflow's Node runs D13's Node side: Node 24.22.1, the Node Windmill 1.862.0's image pins (WR-50); it moves only with the semantics pin.
The CI workflow's second Node runs the npm package's test entry, windmill-lite/bun/testing, on the oldest Node major it supports (harnesses/npm/test/check.sh): only updates within 22.
esbuild is pinned to the version the pinned windmill-cli@1.767.0 bundles with (ADR 0002); the Codebase parity check compares byte for byte, so it moves only with the CLI/semantics pin.
